contentText: Our guests have made it their mission to share their love of the French language and culture around the world, and it is certainly working! They have over 6 million followers on social media, they've done videos with presidents and prime ministers and they're now working on their first book. Their names are Alexandre Durand and Tom Carles, but you might know them better as AT Frenchies. They spoke to us in this edition of Entre Nous.
